title: Home and Field Service Readiness Coordinator
tagline: The fastest truck roll is a failure when the first fact should have stopped ordinary scheduling.

cards: Urgency pushes every symptom toward the scheduling queue.
Gas odor or a CO alarm is not an expedited furnace appointment.
Routine assistance can keep someone inside a dangerous environment.
The first visit is ready—or ordinary service stops immediately.

story.headline: The no-heat call that must never become an appointment
beats: A household reports that the furnace stopped during cold weather.
The same message mentions a rotten-egg odor inside the home.
The agent copies the successful routine no-heat workflow and books a technician.
The safety gate diverts the case before scheduling and preserves technician authority.
